act_title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act No. 22 of 2023)
authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) / Data Protection Board of India

sources.title: Notice and Consent Requirements
sources.summary: Every request for consent must be accompanied or preceded by a notice giving description of personal data sought and purpose of processing, and how data principals can exercise rights. Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action.

sources.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
sources.summary: The Data Principal has the right to withdraw consent at any time, with the ease of doing so comparable to the ease with which such consent was given.

sources.title: Rights of the Data Principal
sources.summary: Data Principals have the right to obtain a summary of personal data being processed, identity of entities data was shared with, right to correction, completion, updating, and erasure of personal data, and grievance redressal.

sources.title: Penalties for Breach
sources.summary: Imposes significant financial penalties up to INR 250 Crores for failure to take reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach, and up to INR 200 Crores for non-fulfillment of obligations in relation to children.
